question: The ratio of the circumferences of two circular flower beds is 3:5. If the smaller flower bed has a radius of 9 m, what is the radius of the larger flower bed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of the circumferences of two circles is directly equal to the ratio of their radii.

Ratio of radii = 3 : 5

3 parts = 9 m (radius of the smaller flower bed)

1 part = 9 ÷ 3 = 3 m

5 parts = 5 × 3 = 15 m (radius of the larger flower bed)

**∴ The correct answer is 15 m.**
